archive_format: 4096-byte SHA256 chunks with a complete file map. Compiled outputs omitted with their recorded identities retained.
qualification: Single native host, fixed configuration order and five samples per case after observed task-owned CPU barriers. Unrelated desktop load, clocks and thermal state are uncontrolled. Ratios use each case median throughput and an equally weighted geometric mean across the 48 Lazy/Lazy2 cases. Standalone features are not each repeated; unused-feature timing does not establish causal benefit. Samples, full frames, exact owners and both campaigns are retained. No universal unsafe speedup, C throughput or foreign-native performance claim.
